We just completed our vendor onboarding and are confirming how Redwood will emit invoices starting Jan 1. Two quick questions so we can route to AP correctly: 

1) Which legal entity will appear as the invoice author (billing "from")? We need to know for our VAT records and for PO matching.
2) Can you support portal push (preferred) or do you need us to accept emailed PDFs only? If portal is available, do you still send email copies for auditors?

Also attaching our PO list for Q1 so you can see the expected PO numbers: Q1_PO_list.csv (attached).

Subject: Re: Billing setup question for Q1 invoices / who creates and where to send

Hi Claire — thanks for the clear info and the PO list. Quick answers + two proposed paths so you can pick what works best for Greenleaf: 

Summary answers
- Invoice author: by default invoices will be issued by "Redwood, Inc." (US issuer) unless you require invoices from our EU sub for local VAT reasons.
- Delivery options: Portal push (preferred) or email PDF + XML/SFTP push. We can do both (portal primary, email copy secondary).

Option A — Portal-first (recommended) - Redwood will push invoices into your portal weekly (PDF + canonical XML payload). - You (or your AP connector) get an automated webhook or SFTP XML as fallback. - We can also send a PDF copy to ap@greenleaflogistics.com for auditor convenience.

Option B — Email-first (paperless fallback) - Redwood emits signed PDF invoices from billing@redwood.com and cc your ap address.

Next steps I need from you:
- Confirm which "invoice author" you require on paper (Redwood, Inc. vs Redwood EU Ltd). If EU issuer required, tell us which VAT entity to use and we will route accordingly.
- Confirm delivery preference: Portal-first with email copies OR Email-only.
- Let us know a test PO we can use (we saw a few in the CSV, but send one you want as the sample).

I will loop in our AP/onboarding team if you choose portal so we can send the invite and the test invoice.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Billing & Onboarding
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Office: +1 (415) 555-0191
